messages:
ryan: Hey team — thinking of a tiny Friday event: 'Mini LAN + Mystery Keys' in the mezzanine. quick, casual, bring-anything setup. who wants in? :joystick:

tay: count me in. i'll bring my switch + dock.

sasha: i can bring a raspberry pi retro station and a few indie steam keys.

mika: i'll grab a couple of extra ethernet cables and a power strip. last time we had cable spaghetti. :sweat_smile:

oliver: can we do a little scavenger hunt for keys? like clues hidden around office. would be fun for remote folks too via hints in the chat.

ryan: love that. plan: hide 5 keys, each clue leads to next. remote participants get riddle-only entries to DM me answers.

poll-bot: POLL by ryan — "Start time for Mini LAN" Options: "6pm", "7pm", "8pm". Votes: Ryan (7pm), Tay (6pm), Sasha (7pm), Mika (7pm), Oliver (8pm).

ryan: looks like 7pm wins. i'll reserve mezzanine 730? (typo here) sorry, editing: reserved 7pm-11pm.

mika: snack queue? chips + something sweet? i'll add a signup.

tay: i'll bring pizza. vegetarian ok?

sasha: yes pls veg options. also small bracket for Smash or TowerFall?

oliver: Smash casuals sound good. i'll set a tiny bracket sheet.

ryan: rules: one key per person. remote folks can enter the riddle raffle. winners DM for key.

dev-bot: Reminder: please don't remove office gear from desks. Report lost items via the help channel.

mika: also labeling: put initials on cables. trust-no-one policy.

ryan: quick note for host: i'll bring a spare travel router. config if we need it:
```
# quick NAT for travel-router
interface wan
set dhcp enable
nat enable
```

tay: anyone need a controller? i have 2 extra pro controllers and a handful of USB adapters.

sasha: bringing a couple of steam decks for rounds. remote folks can spectate via Parsec link i'll post.

poll-bot: POLL by mika — "Snack pickup: who can bring?" Options: "Chips", "Cookies", "Soda". Votes: Mika (Chips), Tay (Cookies), Ryan (Soda).

ryan: final reminders: tidy up after, keep volume reasonable after 10:30, and label chargers. see y'all Friday :party:

oliver: pumped. i'll add sign-ups to the bracket sheet and ping reminders on Friday afternoon.
